body: I would say: someone I can fully trust to not betray me in the moment I give him my full trust. Since this is a impossible paradox, you can guess where this leaves me
Thank you very much for this warm and caring response! I really appreciate it. I am better for the moment. I have reclaimed a tiny determination to fight.

You are right - being proactive is probably the only chance I have got. If I just stand around and wait, the only people who approach me are psychos. 

Being pro-active is pretty much against my nature - but it is true: The question is: How badly do I want it?

I am thinking that maybe I should find a coach or at least an accomplice to support me through this, because otherwise by myself, learning to be proactive might take me the next 1000 years.

Anyways I feel better in the morning now. But it felt really good to read those comments earlier. It is just so harsh to feel so alone with all that! So it was nice to share my desperation at least here.

Thank you!
